name: google-play-console
description: Manage Google Play Console through named, typed actions for every published Android Publisher and Play Developer Reporting API operation.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Play apps, releases, and analytics.
interface.longDescription: Expose each published Android Publisher v3 and Play Developer Reporting v1beta1/v1alpha1 operation as a named, typed MCP action. Manage releases, listings, reviews, monetization, access, analytics, and other API-supported resources. Google permissions remain the authority boundary; high-impact operations require host approval.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Google Play Console to manage my apps and analytics.
